title: Board Capital Resolution — Pacing Reserve on Repeated Class H Preferred Stock Redemptions, Member Equities & Patronage
content:
A Member Equities & Patronage Class H Preferred Stock holding from which a redemption has recently been paid holds back a redemption pacing reserve from what it may redeem next.

## Resolved

1. A holding with a redemption paid within the last 3 whole months holds back 10 percent of its present shares.
2. A holding with a redemption paid within the last 12 whole months but none within the last 3 holds back 5 percent of them.
3. Any other holding holds back nothing.
4. The reserve is taken off the redeemable share amount as well, after the unseasoned shares and the redemption minimum have been dealt with; what remains is never below zero and is taken to the cent.

A redemption paid is a retirement entry on the holding recorded with the reason redemption. Present shares are the holding's purchases plus its reinvested dividends less its retirements. The months are whole calendar months counted back from today.

## Cases (hypothetical holding, present shares 40,000.00, redeemable share amount before the reserve 33,170.00)

| Latest redemption paid | Reserve held back | Redeemable share amount |
|---|---|---|
| 2 months ago | 10 percent of 40,000.00, 4,000.00 | 29,170.00 |
| 7 months ago | 5 percent of 40,000.00, 2,000.00 | 31,170.00 |
| 15 months ago, or never | None | 33,170.00 |

On a holding with present shares of 6,000.00 and 300.00 redeemable before the reserve, a redemption paid 1 month ago holds back 600.00, and the redeemable share amount is 0.00.
